description: instagram: Highlights Details. GET /v1/instagram/user/highlight/detail. Get a story highlight's stories by highlight id (the id from /v1/instagram/user/highlights): id, user, latest_reel_media and items, each with image_versions2 and, for videos, video_versions. Ids past 2^53 (pk) are strings. The title and cover are not in this public call; /v1/instagram/user/highlights has them. Highlights that need a login fail at 0 credits. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

id.description: The highlight id, with or without the highlight: prefix
